page_title_verbatim: FxCraft Example EA – Bollinger Bands mean reversion - expert for MetaTrader 5
author: Jan Jablonski
name: Bollinger Bands Return-to-Mean EA with Optional RSI & Session Window Filter (FxCraft)
economic_rationale: Waiting for bar 1 to re-enter inside the Bollinger Band after a bar-2 outer excursion avoids catching falling knives during momentum breakouts while targeting the 20-period mean.
counterparty_mechanism: Failed breakout traders trapped beyond the 2.0-SD Bollinger band cover positions once price closes back inside the envelope, accelerating reversion to the middle band.
entry_rule: Evaluate on closed bars within configured server-time session window and max spread <= 30 points (max 1 open position): BUY if bar 2 closed below lower BB(20, 2.0) and bar 1 closed back inside bands (optional RSI(14) on bar 2 < 30); SELL symmetric above upper BB (optional RSI > 70).
exit_rule: Exit long when Bid >= middle Bollinger Band, exit short when Ask <= middle Bollinger Band, or optional close outside configured trading hours.
stop_loss_rule: Explicit hard Stop Loss in points (default 300 points; must be kept > 0 for prop compliance), plus spread and free-margin pre-trade checks.
take_profit_rule: Dynamic exit when live Bid/Ask reaches the current 20-period Bollinger middle band.
rule_description: Open-source MQL5 Bollinger Bands (20, 2.0) 2-bar re-entry mean-reversion EA with optional RSI(14, 30/70) filter, configurable server-time trading session window, 30-point spread gate, max 1 open position, middle-band exit, and 300-point default hard Stop Loss. Zero grid, zero martingale.
verbatim_excerpt: Strategy BUY: bar 2 closed below the lower band and bar 1 closed back inside the bands (optionally: RSI on bar 2 below the lower level). Exit: when the price touches the current middle band (BUY: Bid ≥ middle, SELL: Ask ≤ middle) or at Stop Loss.
raw_text: An educational example of a mean-reversion Expert Advisor based on Bollinger Bands. It shows how to combine two indicators, limit trading to selected hours and manage exits based on the current indicator value. Strategy BUY: bar 2 closed below the lower band and bar 1 closed back inside the bands (optionally: RSI on bar 2 below the lower level). SELL – the other way round (upper band, RSI above the upper level). Exit: when the price touches the current middle band (BUY: Bid ≥ middle, SELL: Ask ≤ middle) or at Stop Loss. Trading hours limit only opening new positions (overnight ranges such as 22:00–06:00 are allowed); closing always works. Optionally, positions can be closed outside trading hours. Maximum number of open positions at once – a parameter (1 by default). What the code demonstrates reading two indicators through handles and CopyBuffer with a check of the number of copied values, an optional filter that can be switched on and off, time windows in server time, including ranges that cross midnight, free margin, lot and stop level checks, spread filter, order retries. Inputs TimeFrame – timeframe of the signal (current chart by default) Bollinger Bands period / deviation / applied price – 20 / 2.0 / Close Use RSI filter – off by default; RSI period 14, lower level 30 (BUY below), upper level 70 (SELL above) Trading start / end (HH:MM, server time) – 00:00 / 00:00 (start = end → all day) Close position outside trading hours – off Lot (fixed) – 0.10; Stop Loss – in points, 0 = none (300) Max open positions at once – 1 Magic number – 5020; Max slippage – 10 points; Max spread – 30 points (0 = off) Important This is an educational example, not a trading system. It works only on demo accounts and in the Strategy Tester – on a live account it shows a message and stops. Provided "as is", without any warranty. Not investment advice. Clean, commented MQL5 code with margin and stop level checks. Demo and Strategy Tester only. Spread Monitor Spread Monitor is an MQL5 Expert Advisor that draws a colour-coded panel on the chart. The panel shows the current spread of the attached symbol in points, along with the average, minimum, and maximum over a rolling history. It also counts how many stored samples exceeded a warning level, and turns the status row red when the current spread is above that level. The utility does not place orders. Inputs control the warning level, the history size, the refresh interval, and the panel position. Panel objects are removed when the EA is detached.
